description: Lists current sources/suppliers from WAPI for one visible store/channel, optionally filtered by visible countryCode. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

countryCode.description: Optional visible country code, for example UK, US, ES, FR, DE, AU or IT.

name: hgr_get_sources
title: Get Sources
